homepage.hero_description: Grand Lake's premier Bentley, Harris, Trifecta & Dockside dealer. New & used boats, pontoon rentals, full-service marina, and always the cheapest gas on the water.
homepage.rentals_heading: Get Out on the Water Today
homepage.rentals_description: No boat? No problem. Rent one of our pontoons and enjoy everything Grand Lake has to offer — fishing, cruising, tubing, or just soaking up the sun.
homepage.about_heading: The Newest Dealership. The Most Experience.
homepage.about_paragraph_one: Lakeshore Marina is the newest dealership on Grand Lake St. Marys — and we're here to do things right. We know boats, we know this lake, and we know how to take care of our customers.
homepage.about_paragraph_two: Our mission is simple: help people get out on the water and enjoy their boating activities. We're here to be an asset to our customers — a marina you can count on. Stop by and say hi, grab some gas, and see for yourself why you want to be our customer.
